title: Scientists discover hidden brain changes linked to common sleep disorders
caption:
A massive review of 57 brain scans shows sleep disorders shrink a key attention hub. Parasomnias also affect emotion centers, while insomnia and apnea share the same changes. Understanding these links could guide future treatments.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover hidden brain changes linked to common sleep disorders

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261104012303.htm
